source: Bios and headshots supplied by the event organizer; bios preserved as supplied. Order follows the organizer’s list, not a confirmed running order.

speakers.name: Xiomara Figueroa
speakers.title: Lead Engineer
speakers.bio: Lead engineer at Red Ventures, building an agentic platform for enterprise businesses. Xiomara previously took a startup from zero to acquisition as its CTO. She has nearly 10 years of full-stack experience and has spent the last three working almost entirely in AI. Outside her day job, she co-founded and launched AMI, an AI-powered women's health app for women dealing with hormonal and chronic conditions like endometriosis and PCOS.

speakers.name: Bryan Collazo Santiago
speakers.title: Senior Software Engineer
speakers.bio: Senior Software Engineer and former CTO with over 10 years of experience. Bryan currently builds AI agents for enterprises at GREP.ai. He holds a Bachelor's degree and an M.Eng. in Artificial Intelligence from MIT.

speakers.name: Christian Rodríguez Encarnación
speakers.title: Engineer
speakers.bio: Engineer at Parcha Labs, where he focuses on the system architecture and agentic infrastructure behind GREP.ai. He's passionate about building with AI coding agents and the evolving software development landscape.

speakers.name: Rigoberto Miranda
speakers.title: Principal Software Engineer and Lead of AI R&D
speakers.bio: Principal Software Engineer and Lead of AI R&D at Red Ventures Puerto Rico. Rigoberto also builds CodeXpr.ai, an AI legal research assistant for Puerto Rico's legal system, which earned a technology award from the Colegio de Abogados y Abogadas de Puerto Rico. He studied at the Polytechnic University of Puerto Rico.

speakers.name: Miguel Rios Berrios
speakers.title: Founder
speakers.bio: Founder of Parcha Labs, the makers of GREP.ai and AgentRun.ai. He was Senior Director of Engineering at Brex, leading the Platform Engineering organization, and Head of Data Science at Twitter.
